# Locations & Battles

## Aden {#aden}

Aden is a town situated on a promontory joined to the mainland by a narrow isthmus, featuring octagon minarets and fortifications rebuilt by the English after they took possession of the site in 1839.

## Africa {#africa}

Africa is a continent that borders the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) Sea and was once joined to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) by land.

## Amazon {#amazon}

The Amazon is a river featuring a vast estuary whose significant discharge freshens the surrounding seawater for several leagues.

## Antarctic {#antarctic}

The Antarctic is a desolate, volcanic region characterized by vast ice-fields, floating icebergs, and a continent inhabited by various birds and sea-mammals.

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) becomes trapped in an impassable field of ice while navigating the Antarctic. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals his audacious plan to reach the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) by traveling beneath the icebergs, and after preparing the vessel, he successfully maneuvers the submarine into the depths to continue their journey.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) prepares to navigate beneath a massive iceberg to reach the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole). After a tense journey submerged under the ice, during which the vessel repeatedly strikes the overhead ice ceiling, the submarine finally emerges into open water.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is struck by an iceberg and becomes trapped in an icy tunnel. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) works to maneuver the vessel, but after several shocks and failed attempts to navigate the passage, he informs the narrator that all exits are blocked, leaving them trapped.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT?

## Antilles {#antilles}

The Antilles are a group of islands located near a vast submarine valley in the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.

## Arabia {#arabia}

Arabia is a region bordering the Sea of [Oman](../codex/places.md#oman) that features curious coasts and is situated near the [Indian Peninsula](../codex/places.md#indian-peninsula).

## Asia {#asia}

Asia is a continent that borders the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean and serves as a geographical reference point for the Kuro-Scivo current.

## Atlantis {#atlantis}

Atlantis is an ancient, submerged continent located beyond [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), [Asia](../codex/places.md#asia), and Lybia that contains the ruins of a once-great civilization featuring temples, aqueducts, and streets.

## Australia {#australia}

Australia is a location off the east coast of which a mysterious, enormous aquatic creature was sighted by the steamer Governor Higginson on July 20, 1866.

## Brest {#brest}

Brest is a French port city that serves as the location of an arsenal whose foundry produced a bronze clock found among the wreckage of the vessels commanded by [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md).

## Brooklyn {#brooklyn}

Brooklyn is a location in [New York](../codex/places.md#new-york) bordering the East River that features a pier where the frigate [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) was stationed before its departure.

## Cadiz {#cadiz}

Cadiz is a Spanish port that historically held the exclusive privilege of receiving merchandise arriving from the West Indies.

## Calcutta {#calcutta}

Calcutta is a city where Captain [Dillon](../character/dillon.md) sought support from the Asiatic Society and the Indian Company for his expedition to locate the remains of the [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md) shipwreck.

## Cancer {#cancer}

The tropic of Cancer is a geographic line of latitude crossed by vessels navigating the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean.

## Cape Horn {#cape-horn}

Cape Horn is a solitary island and lost rock located at the extremity of the American continent that was named by Dutch sailors after their native town.

## Capricorn {#capricorn}

The tropic of Capricorn is a geographical line of latitude crossed by the frigate [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during its voyage.

## Ceylon {#ceylon}

Ceylon is an island located near the [Indian Peninsula](../codex/places.md#indian-peninsula), known for its pearl-fisheries and as a destination for the P. O. Company's steamship route.

## China {#china}

China is a country that has been visited by the narrator during his extensive travels.

## Columbus {#columbus}

The Columbus is a vessel belonging to the West India and [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Steam Navigation Company that observed an extraordinary cetaceous creature in the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean on July 23, 1866.

## Crespo {#crespo}

Crespo is a small, desert island in the [North Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), also known as Rocca de la [Plata](../codex/places.md#plata), which features a submarine forest.

## Crete {#crete}

Crete, also known as Candia, is an island where the local population has risen in insurrection against the Turks, and whose surrounding waters are occasionally visited by the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).

## Egypt {#egypt}

Egypt is a country featuring curious coasts and a plain across which ancient rulers historically attempted to construct a canal connecting the [Nile](../codex/places.md#nile) to the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea).

## England {#england}

England is a country that treated the reports of a mysterious aquatic monster with serious consideration.

## Europe {#europe}

Europe is a continent located across the ocean from [America](../codex/places.md#united-states), connected to it by an electric telegraph cable laid along the sea floor.

## European {#european}

European refers to the seas and shores near the continent of [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), which the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates while remaining in proximity to its coasts.

## France {#france}

France is a nation whose government employs an Assistant Professor at the Museum of Natural History in [Paris](../codex/places.md#paris).

## Gibraltar {#gibraltar}

The Straits of Gibraltar serve as a narrow passage connecting the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) to the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic), characterized by an under-current that facilitates the movement of surplus water between the two basins.

## Gilboa {#gilboa}

Gilboa is an island characterized by a remarkable border of screw-pines and a dense forest of tropical flora, including mimosas, figs, and abundant bread-fruit trees.

> After the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) runs aground on a reef near the island of Gilboa, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains calm and expresses confidence that the upcoming full moon's tide will refloat the vessel. [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) receive permission from the Captain to go ashore to hunt for fresh game. The trio successfully reaches the island, with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) eager to find land-based food.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS

## Good Hope {#good-hope}

The Cape of Good Hope is a geographic location that has been considered as a potential point for the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to pass during its voyage.

## Greenland {#greenland}

Greenland is a region associated with the hunting of a specific species of whale that does not traverse the warm waters of the equator.

## Gulf Stream {#gulf-stream}

The Gulf Stream is a location that has not been encountered or described during the current voyage.

## Havannah {#havannah}

Havannah is a location associated with the production of tobacco.

## India {#india}

India is a distant region connected to the trade networks of [Egypt](../codex/places.md#egypt), [Syria](../codex/places.md#syria), and Turkey through the counting-house of Djeddah.

## Indian Ocean {#indian-ocean}

The Indian Ocean is a vast, clear, and transparent liquid plain covering 1,200,000,000 acres that serves as a habitat for various aquatic birds and diverse species of fish, including ostracions and petrodon.

> The narrator reflects on the mysterious nature of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) while the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the Indian Ocean. During the journey, the crew observes various marine life, including shoals of argonauts and sharks, and witnesses the natural phenomenon of a 'milk sea' caused by bioluminescent organisms.
>
> — v2 · PART TWO

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on a submarine excursion to the pearl banks of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon). While observing a native diver, the group witnesses a shark attack; Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) engages the shark in a life-or-death struggle, and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) ultimately kills the beast with his harpoon. The group rescues the Indian diver and returns him to his boat before attempting to revive him.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS

## Indian Peninsula {#indian-peninsula}

The Indian Peninsula is a geographical region associated with the island of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon), which is described as a pearl hanging from its lobe.

## Ireland {#ireland}

Ireland is a coastal region located near the site of an underwater electric cable rupture and is situated near the route taken by the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) as it rounds the Emerald Isle.

## Italy {#italy}

Italy is a nation that participated in inquiries regarding the existence of a submarine vessel and is noted for the development of underwater gun technology by Landi.

## Japanese {#japanese}

The coast of Japan is a region that was explored by the crew of the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during their search for a mysterious monster in the Northern [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific).

## Jardin {#jardin}

The Jardin des [Plantes](../codex/places.md#plantes) is a location in [France](../codex/places.md#france) that houses a museum and serves as the site of a lodging associated with Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md).

## Lawrence {#lawrence}

The St. Lawrence is one of the largest rivers in the world that waters the shores of the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.

## Liverpool {#liverpool}

Liverpool is a port city served by steamers traveling to and from [New York](../codex/places.md#new-york).

## London {#london}

London is a city where certain cigar shapes and industrial constructions are known to originate.

## Long Island {#long-island}

Long Island is a coastal location situated near the port of [New York](../codex/places.md#new-york) where the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) encountered a severe hurricane.

## Manche {#manche}

The Manche is a body of water located near the British Isles and the coast of [France](../codex/places.md#france) that the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) has the potential to navigate.

## Marquesas {#marquesas}

The Marquesas are a group of islands in the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean that belong to [France](../codex/places.md#france) and include the island of Nouka-Hiva.

## Mediterranean {#mediterranean}

The Mediterranean is a sea bordered by [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) and [Africa](../codex/places.md#africa) that is characterized by its transparent air, surrounding mountains, and frequent underground volcanic activity.

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels at high speed through the Mediterranean, preventing [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) from attempting an escape. During the journey, the narrator discusses geological history and the future of the earth with [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) while the vessel navigates past submarine barriers. [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) eventually exits the Mediterranean through the Straits of [Gibraltar](../codex/places.md#gibraltar) and enters the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic).
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS

## Mexico {#mexico}

The [Gulf](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream) of Mexico is a body of water that serves as a source for trochi, a type of mollusc characterized by its imbricated shell.

## Mississippi {#mississippi}

The Mississippi is a river that flows into the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.

## Mohammed {#mohammed}

The Cape of Ras-Mohammed is a geographical feature that forms the extremity of [Arabia](../codex/places.md#arabia) Petraea, located between the [Gulf](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream) of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) and the [Gulf](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream) of Acabah.

## Nea Kamenni {#nea-kamenni}

Nea Kamenni is a volcanic location near the Island of [Santorin](../codex/places.md#santorin) that serves as a reference point for the emergence of new, ephemeral islands formed by submarine eruptions.

## New Caledonia {#new-caledonia}

New Caledonia is a location characterized by the presence of barrier reefs formed by the calcareous deposits of madrepores.

## New York {#new-york}

New York is a city in the [United States](../codex/places.md#united-states) where the narrator arrived at the end of March following a scientific research expedition and where he was subsequently consulted regarding the mysterious monster terrorizing the seas.

> Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) recounts the public debate surrounding a mysterious sea monster that damaged the [Scotia](../codex/tech.md#scotia), eventually publishing an article suggesting it is a giant narwhal. Following this, the [United States](../codex/places.md#united-states) prepares an expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to hunt the creature. [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) receives an official invitation from the Secretary of Marine to join [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md) on the voyage.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II PRO AND CON

## New Zealand {#new-zealand}

New Zealand is a region associated with the origin of a rare specimen of shell found within the collection of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).

## Newfoundland {#newfoundland}

The Bank of Newfoundland is an area of shallow sea consisting of alluvia and organic matter, where erratic blocks and molluscs accumulate.

## Nile {#nile}

The Nile is a river that was historically utilized by the ancients as an intermediate route for commercial communication between the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) and the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) through a canal system that was subject to various construction, restoration, and destruction efforts over many centuries.

## North Atlantic {#north-atlantic}

The North Atlantic is a vast ocean region traversed by the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), containing the [Sargasso Sea](../codex/places.md#sargasso-sea) and areas of extreme depth where soundings have failed to reach the bottom.

> After failing to escape the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) confirm their location in the middle of the ocean. Later, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) on a deep-sea excursion, where they walk along the ocean floor to discover the ruins of the lost continent of [Atlantis](../codex/places.md#atlantis) illuminated by an underwater volcano.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) enters an underwater cavern inside an extinct volcano, which Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) uses as a secret base to mine coal and replenish his sodium reserves. Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) explore the interior of the volcanic crater, where they gather honey and hunt game. After the crew completes their work, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) departs the refuge to continue its voyage through the Atlantic.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES

## North Pacific {#north-pacific}

The North Pacific is a vast oceanic region traversed by the frigate [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during an extensive and ultimately unsuccessful search for a mysterious monster.

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads the narrator and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on an extensive underwater excursion through a submarine forest near the Island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo). During the journey, they hunt marine life, encounter dangerous sea creatures, and use electric lamps to navigate the depths before safely returning to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI A SUBMARINE FOREST

## Norway {#norway}

Norway is a coastal destination toward which one of the two arms of the [Gulf Stream](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream) current flows.

> The narrator, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) find themselves safe in a fisherman's hut on the Loffoden Isles after escaping the maelstrom. The narrator reflects on their incredible journey and wonders about the fate of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), hoping that the captain has found peace.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XXIII CONCLUSION

## Oceania {#oceania}

Oceania is a region characterized by its coral reefs and islands whose hydrographical bearings were fixed by the navigator Dumont d'Urville.

## Oman {#oman}

Oman is a country featuring the important town of Muscat, which is characterized by its white houses, forts, mosques, and minarets situated against black rocks.

## Papua {#papua}

Papua is a region whose coasts were sighted by the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) on the 4th of January, marking the vessel's approach toward the Strait of Torres.

> Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) spend two days exploring the island of Papua, hunting for game and gathering tropical fruits to supplement their diet on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). After a successful hunt that includes capturing a bird of paradise and several kangaroos, the trio enjoys a feast on the shore and briefly contemplates not returning to the ship before their conversation is interrupted by a mysterious stone thrown at them.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND

## Paris {#paris}

Paris is the location of the Museum of Natural History, where [Pierre Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) serves as an Assistant Professor.

## Plantes {#plantes}

The [Jardin](../codex/places.md#jardin) des Plantes is a location in [Paris](../codex/places.md#paris) that houses a museum and serves as the site of a lodging and animal exhibits.

## Plata {#plata}

The Plata is a large estuary on the coast of South [America](../codex/places.md#united-states) that the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) passed beyond while traveling northwards.

## Prussia {#prussia}

Prussia is one of the nations that conducted inquiries regarding the existence of a submarine monitor, and it is also the location where the engine for the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) was manufactured.

## Quebec {#quebec}

Quebec is a town that formerly belonged to [France](../codex/places.md#france) and was home to a tribe of hardy fishermen.

## Red Sea {#red-sea}

The Red Sea is a gulf entered through the Straits of Bab-el-mandeb, known for its submarine wonders, coral, and historical reputation as a dangerous body of water.

## Rhodes {#rhodes}

Rhodes is an island referenced in relation to the geographical location of the Island of Scarpanto, which is situated between Rhodes and [Crete](../codex/places.md#crete).

## Santorin {#santorin}

Santorin is a volcanic area of the sea characterized by submarine eruptions and the frequent emergence of new islands, such as Theia, George Island, Aphroessa, and Reka.

## Sargasso Sea {#sargasso-sea}

The Sargasso Sea is a quiet, immovable region of the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean characterized by a dense, meadow-like accumulation of seaweed and floating debris trapped within the circular current of the [Gulf Stream](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream).

## South Pole {#south-pole}

The South Pole is a deserted continent consisting of a chaotic heap of rocks and ice, where Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) claimed possession of the territory on the 21st of March, 1868.

> Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) explore the [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) coast, observing the local wildlife and volcanic terrain while searching for the South Pole. [The Captain](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains anxious to observe the sun at noon to confirm their exact location before the onset of the six-month polar night. Despite their efforts, poor weather conditions repeatedly prevent the necessary astronomical observations, leaving the final confirmation for the following day.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) travel to a peak in the [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) to observe the sun at the equinox. Using a chronometer and instruments, they confirm their arrival at the South Pole at noon. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) then plants a black flag to claim the territory in his own name.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE

## Spain {#spain}

Spain is a nation whose history includes a 1702 conflict involving the reign of Philip V and the arrival of a convoy of galleons in [Vigo Bay](../codex/places.md#vigo-bay).

## Suez {#suez}

The Isthmus of Suez is a region in [Egypt](../codex/places.md#egypt) where a canal has been constructed to connect the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) and the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean), facilitating a shorter maritime route between [Cadiz](../codex/places.md#cadiz) and [India](../codex/places.md#india).

## Syria {#syria}

Syria is a coastal region where soft sponges are found and where fish marked with rings have been recovered from the sea.

## Torres Straits {#torres-straits}

The Torres Straits are a nearly thirty-four league wide passage obstructed by numerous islands, islets, breakers, and rocks that render navigation through the area almost impracticable.

## United States {#united-states}

The United States is a nation whose shores were sighted by the crew of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) as they navigated the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.

## Vanikoro {#vanikoro}

Vanikoro is a group of volcanic islands surrounded by a coral reef where the vessels Boussole and [Astrolabe](../codex/tech.md#astrolabe), commanded by [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md), were wrecked.

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), eventually arriving at Vanikoro, the site of the [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md) shipwreck. The narrator recounts the history of the search for the lost vessels, after which Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals he has discovered the final resting place of the survivors' makeshift boat and possesses the original naval instructions from the expedition.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO

## Vanou {#vanou}

Vanou is a small harbour located on the island of [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro), known as the site where the vessels of [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md) were wrecked and subsequently investigated by various expeditions.

## Vigo Bay {#vigo-bay}

Vigo Bay is an open road on the northwest coast of [Spain](../codex/places.md#spain) where, on October 22, 1702, a fleet of Spanish galleons laden with American gold and silver was scuttled by Admiral Chateau-Renaud to prevent the treasure from falling into the hands of an English fleet.

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) plans an escape attempt for that night, leaving Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) in a state of anxious indecision. However, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) stops in Vigo Bay, where Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) interrupts [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to recount the history of the sunken Spanish galleons. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) then reveals that he has been harvesting the immense treasure from these wrecks to fund his operations.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY

> Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) observes the crew of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) salvaging gold and silver from the historic wreckage in Vigo Bay. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) explains that he uses these treasures to aid the oppressed and suffering, revealing that his wealth serves a humanitarian purpose rather than personal greed.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY
